_readme: Template only. Copy to training.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Step 4 (main_train_detector.py). detection.json includes it, so that a model there can name one of these training runs.

training._readme: Settings for main_train_detector.py. data_yaml = the Ultralytics dataset yaml. p2_model_yaml = the P2-head architecture yaml, used when p2 is true; its file name must match version and size (e.g. yolo11s-p2.yaml). gpu = GPU id, or a list of ids for multi-GPU. wandb_project / wandb_group = where the run logs in Weights & Biases (enable with 'yolo settings wandb=True'); the run is named yolo_<size>_<version>_<base|p2>[_scratch][_<tag>]. version / size pick the model, e.g. 12 + 's' = yolo12s. load_pretrained loads the standard model's pretrained weights (yolo<version><size>.pt), also into the P2 architecture; false trains from scratch. weights_dir = folder holding those pretrained weights (missing ones are downloaded there); null = <output_dir>/training/pretrained. train_args are passed straight to Ultralytics model.train() (any of its arguments: epochs, batch, imgsz, workers, patience, mosaic, scale, ...). The run is written to <output_dir>/training/<wandb_project>/<run name>/ (_2, _3, ... if that run name exists). To evaluate it, put the run name in a model's model_path instead of a path to its weights.
